archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST (Developer Command Center)

theme_strategy.rationale: Developer tools & diff viewers excel in deep Obsidian dark mode (#0D1117 / #161B22) matching GitHub / JetBrains aesthetics, with high contrast syntax highlighting and tactical status accents.

visual_enhancers.grid_pattern: Technical subtle grid background using border/5 opacity and dot matrix textures.
visual_enhancers.border_style: 1px solid crisp borders (#2A3447 in dark, #E2E8F0 in light) with sharp or subtle rounded corners (rounded-lg / rounded-md).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80 (Dark) or bg-white/85 (Light) with 1px explicit border for floating headers and dialog overlays. NEVER complete transparent background.
visual_enhancers.badges: Monospace pill badges for Git status (ADDED, MODIFIED, UNCHANGED, DIRECT_COMMIT, PR_CREATED, SECRET_WARNING).
visual_enhancers.diff_viewer: Split or side-by-side / unified code diff container with line numbers, green addition highlights (+), red deletion highlights (-), and secret scan warning highlights.

layout_structure.header: Top bar containing brand title, PAT connection badge, GitHub avatar, rate-limit meter, and dry-run toggle.
layout_structure.col_left_config: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 space-y-6 (PAT setup, Repo & Branch picker, Source Picker file tree & DB snapshots, drag-drop upload zone)
layout_structure.col_right_preview: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 space-y-6 (Dry-run diff viewer, secret scanning warnings, file size warnings, execution action bar with Push button)
layout_structure.bottom_history: col-span-12 (Push History Table with timestamp, mode, files count, commit/PR links, status badges)

component_styling.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md buttons with strong focus ring, hover brightness, and loading spinners. Primary action button 'Push to GitHub' glows subtly in dark mode.
component_styling.inputs: Shadcn input / custom select with explicit focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500) and dark input backgrounds (#161B22).
component_styling.cards: Cardless or sharp rectangular cards with 1px border (#2A3447) and subtle hover background transition.
component_styling.file_tree: Interactive checkbox file tree with folder expansion, file extension badges, file size indicator, and drag&drop upload target.
component_styling.diff_view: Unified diff line renderer with line numbers, green/red row fills, line modification indicators, and jump-to-warning shortcuts.
component_styling.rate_limit_meter: Progress bar showing remaining API calls (e.g. 4850 / 5000) with color coding (Green > 50%, Yellow 20-50%, Red < 20%).

animations.card_entrance: Fade in + slight slide up (y: 10 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1)
animations.diff_expand: Accordion or height smooth transition for diff lines
animations.push_progress: Interactive multi-step execution loader (1. Reading HEAD SHA -> 2. Secret Scan -> 3. Checking divergence -> 4. Creating commit / branch & PR)
animations.toast_notifications: Sonner toasts for success (PR created link), errors (PAT invalid), and secret detection warnings.

media_and_assets.icon_library: lucide-react (GitBranch, GitCommit, GitPullRequest, ShieldAlert, FileCode, Database, RefreshCw, Key, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, ExternalLink, HardDrive, Eye, Play, Lock)

3d_and_creative_components.library: Not required for core diff viewing, but subtle CSS matrix or scanline grid animation can be added behind the header metric bar.

accessibility.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='pat-input', data-testid='push-to-github-button', data-testid='diff-preview-container', data-testid='push-history-table').
accessibility.contrast: APCA high contrast for code diff text, secret alerts, and status badges against dark background.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete single-user Web App in JavaScript React (.js files).

Implement the 5-step flow seamlessly: 1. PAT + Repo/Branch selector -> 2. Source file selection (Workspace tree, DB snapshots, Uploads) -> 3. Dry-run diff preview with secret & file size scanning -> 4. Push execution with direct commit vs Branch+PR automatic detection -> 5. Real-time result view and persistent history log.
Implement encrypted PAT local storage / session simulation with quick disconnect/connect capabilities.
Ensure GitHub rate limit meter is live and updates after API actions.
Ensure secret scan flags potential API keys, RSA keys, .env tokens in files prior to commit and shows clear warnings.
Provide a unified or side-by-side diff preview component with line numbers and added/modified line highlighting.
Add sample workspace files, database collections (JSON/BSON snapshots), uploaded files, and markdown docs so the user can test the app immediately out of the box.
Always attach data-testid attributes on form controls, buttons, tables, badges, and alerts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and uniform slop. Use dense, high-contrast developer tool grid styling.
DO NOT use dark colors as soft gradients; use solid slate/obsidian panels with crisp 1px borders.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or floating headers. Use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque background.
Ensure hover states explicitly set text colors (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
Use sonner for toast notifications (located in src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or via toast).
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for navigation or badges. Use Lucide icons instead.
